audit_type: Read-only reusable factual-check workflow code audit, separate from final output snapshot audit
scope: research/build_deliverables.py manifest discovery and explicit issue inputs
research/build_screening_pool.py canonical factual annotations and preservation
method: Full static read of the named code, inspection of protocols/schema/current admissions, read-only captured execution with all Path.write_text calls intercepted in memory, independent current mapping and original-hash comparisons, eight disposable metadata negative checks, and fresh exact text extraction comparisons for all 30 new-batch originals. No code/data/report outputs were modified by the audit.

checks.details: Global protocol allocations must be exhaustive and disjoint, protocol IDs unique, and peer rotation must cover each researcher independently once. Initial explicit page lists must cover all physical pages. Exact peer claim IDs and required document-page coverage are checked. Current protocols satisfy these gates.

Each peer file is bound to the expected target inventory path and exact SHA256. Non-accept dispositions require root decisions; claim identity and provenance cannot be changed by updates. Additional claims require explicit root review and actual peer omission document, pages and reviewer binding.

Every actual omission needs exactly one nonempty disposition referencing existing claims or an explicit exclusion. Orphan review-file/index references are rejected. Current four BEHG additional claims bind correctly to the original peer omissions.

Conflicting source identities are rejected across inventories, peer sources and additions; archive hashes and PDF signatures are checked; unusable evidence cannot support claims. Every original PDF hash/page count is checked. Saved author text must exactly match fresh pdftotext -layout output. Anchors must occur in cited pages or use a visual review bound to image hash, original PDF hash, pages, excerpt and reviewer. Source relevance, primary status, dates and the adequacy of short anchors still require substantive review.

No claim-ledger outcome is automatically promoted. Deliverables use explicit assembly manifest inputs. The batch validator requires manifest IDs to agree with root admissions and each admitted issue to reference a final contradicted/overstated claim. Registered final candidate-review and staged-record hashes are checked. Missing explicit inputs fail. Current extension manifest names exactly the separately admitted BEHG mortality-range issue.

Each of the 7 old-pilot, 9 BEHG and 21 network originals matches exactly one existing included canonical reading unit; all matches include the exact original path. Every batch original hash matches. Independent author/title inspection found no false link; distinct canonical targets equal document counts in each set. This includes BEHG and network records whose canonical IDs differ from batch IDs.

Read-only execution reproduces exactly 626 included units, the identical canonical ID set, zero differences in preserved title/process/depth/kind/inclusion/identity/path/URL/related-issue fields, and all 7 old-pilot annotations unchanged. The factual annotation loop creates no reading rows and records repeat_read_adds_unit false.

The index requires every configured summary to say complete. Bounded coverage retains finite-population and every-assertion limits and annotates the corresponding existing process rather than adding reading counts. Both these builders, and pool annotations, consume cached completed summaries/ledgers; they do not independently revalidate raw hashes on every downstream invocation.

concerns_resolved_during_review.concern: Allocation omissions and fully_read flag could pass without exact explicit page coverage
A valid hash for the wrong inventory was not rejected
Omission resolutions lacked valid disposition, claim references and actual peer binding
Additional source metadata could overwrite source identity
An arbitrary existing image could bypass failed text anchors
Saved text could diverge from the archived author PDF
Adjudication updates could rewrite immutable claim provenance
Missing explicit issue input could be silently skipped
Explicit admissions needed agreement with final error claims and reviewed candidate snapshots

open_concerns.title: Downstream cached completion requires an ordered rebuild and final snapshot audit
open_concerns.details: Index, pool and bounded-coverage builders trust the saved complete summaries and ledgers. They can expose stale completion if run without rebuilding an upstream batch after inputs change. This is not a detected defect in the current reviewed document mapping.
open_concerns.action: After final adjudication and candidate decisions, rebuild each batch from its current raw inputs, then the extension index and deliverables, then the pool and bounded coverage. Independently audit the resulting exact artifact hashes, totals, report links, admissions and preservation before describing the final extension as complete.

read_only_execution_proof.method: Executed unchanged screening-pool and deliverables builders in a fresh process with Path.write_text intercepted into memory; no data, code, manifests or reports written.

final_batch_validator_proof.method: Unchanged code executed with JSON reads overridden by disposable in-memory fixture transformations and every Path.write_text captured in memory. No actual input or generated output modified. Archive reads remain the actual bytes; these tests check rejection of the injected metadata defects.

captured_summary.page_scope: Physical PDF pages, including committee covers and appendices where present.
captured_summary.scope: All nine response PDFs listed on the official October 7, 2026 BEHG hearing page; academics and municipal umbrella included as external stakeholders. Not the entire legislative-process or three-channel corpus.
limits: Nine previously examined public hearing responses, 60 physical PDF pages including committee covers. Not the complete legislative-process population.

Inventories target material testable premises, not every incidental factual assertion. Supported is bounded to the proposition and source/version stated; unresolved is neither an error nor confirmation.
Claims are judged as of authored dates. Covers, hearing dates and actual delivery are distinct. Current official files are not independently authenticated copies of each original delivery.
Pure policy preferences and forecasts are recorded in page exclusions; model descriptions, assumptions and observable causal premises remain assessable.
No author contact, human specialist confirmation, intent inference or representative error rate.
conclusions: All nine archived external responses and all60physical PDF pages were re-read;190initial claims received complete independent peer review. Root separately adjudicated five peer omissions, extending one existing assessment and adding four premises.

One narrow minor overstatement is admitted: the corrected cited urban mortality table does not support a five-to-fifteen cold/heat ratio in every country group. Its larger aggregate cold burden and the German cohort ratio remain intact. The direction of the correction is unknown because country deviations are mixed.

No new major finding is admitted. The infrasound threshold, net-feedback and measured-versus-modelled candidates remain unresolved after fair contextual alternatives and source-scope limits were tested.

The earlier public July consultation draft, official auction series, coalition agreement and technology-specific EEG payment table resolved several access gaps in favour of supported assessments. Unresolved assessments remain separate from main issue counts.
